purpose: Read-only behavioral rehearsals. Assess decisions and usable navigation, not exact wording. Do not execute fixture commands or alter real repositories.

cases.prompt: Propose a discoverable engineering guidance hierarchy with a root table of contents and architecture guidance. Reconcile docs with the current code, and make validation discoverable for planners and implementers. Keep it proportionate; do not change code.
checks: Preserve approved worker-only persistence and identify API direct writing as a deviation.
Correct the proposed API description without authorizing the deviation or claiming migration complete.
Provide a root instruction route to a compact engineering index; reuse existing authoritative guides.
Notice ignored docs/engineering and choose an accessible alternative or state the tracking decision explicitly.
Expose missing broker procedure and absent package/test evidence without inventing commands or claiming tests passed.
Bound audit coverage and preserve read-only scope.

cases.prompt: Audit documentation impact only. A private helper was renamed; interfaces, behavior, ownership, setup and tests are unchanged. The component README links to the old filename and the parent index links to the component README. No new component was added.
checks: Identify the broken implementation link for repair.
Do not demand architecture rewrites or new guides for every directory.
Explain why other authoritative content remains valid; do not edit in audit mode.
Do not start a charter interview; at most report the absent charter as a gap.

cases.prompt: Prepare documentation changes for a proposed migration from API writes to worker-only persistence. Implementation has not started. Architecture already approves worker-only ownership; current API documentation truthfully records legacy direct writes. Work is documentation-only.
checks: Keep current direct-write behavior documented as an existing deviation.
Label migration and associated validation proposals as future work.
Do not claim current compliance or authorize code changes.
Identify component, architecture deviation, and validation explanations that will need reconciliation when implementation lands.

cases.prompt: Set up guidance for this repository. Do not write files; show what you would establish and what you need from me. Evidence: root AGENTS.md has setup commands only and names no engineering entry point. site/ holds static marketing pages built by a script and published by a pipeline on merge. app/ holds a subscription web application with a database, deployed by the same pipeline. ads/ holds scheduled scripts that call an advertising platform API using a stored credential to create campaigns and adjust daily budgets from sales data; no spending limit or approval step appears anywhere. The owner says: I know the application side well. I have never run advertising before and I do not know what I should be worried about. For the site I just want something to start with.
checks: Infer the uninitialized state from the evidence; do not ask whether this is a new setup.
Propose three responsibilities as outcomes with evidence, and seek confirmation of the list before deep interviews.
Use the stated starter ambition for the site and ask the owner for the others; do not shorten or widen the interview by guessing at the owner's expertise.
Raise unbounded automated spending and missing approval regardless of ambition level, as an exposure for the owner to decide, not a rule already adopted.
Recognize the shared delivery pipeline once instead of asking about it per responsibility.
Present researched practices as candidates with costs and a labeled recommendation; do not write a catalog into guidance or claim owner approval.
End in an explicit stopping state and preserve the no-write boundary.
Treat what the scan found as existing, not endorsed, until the owner gives it a standing.

cases.prompt: Update our guidance; a contributor just added a weekly email digest job under jobs/digest that sends to all customers. The engineering entry point has this marker: contract 0.3.0, reviewed 2026-09-02, responsibilities marketing-site complete, saas-product complete, advertising in-progress. Its table records for marketing-site: Health declined, static pages, revisit if a form is added. The site is unchanged and has no form. Advertising has Exposure adopted with a daily spend limit and Authority still open.
checks: Do not rerun completed interviews or reopen the declined site health decision, since its revisit condition has not occurred.
Identify customer email as an unrecorded responsibility or a material extension that needs an owner decision, with its exposure named.
Do not restart advertising; report its open authority concern as remaining and resume it only within establish scope or on request.
Keep adopted-but-unimplemented practices distinct from present behavior and route any building to change-scoped work.

cases.prompt: Establish guidance. This repository is three shell scripts I run by hand to rename and archive my own photos on my laptop. No pipeline, no credentials, no network calls. I am the only user. Keep it proportionate.
checks: Record a single responsibility without manufacturing others.
Do not recommend deployment, monitoring, or dependency machinery; say plainly where doing nothing is the recommendation.
Still name irreversible loss of files as the one exposure worth a decision.
Produce a small charter, not a hierarchy of guides.
Record an unanswered recommendation as open, not declined, and do not create an instruction file only to hold a pointer.

cases.prompt: Establish guidance for the billing responsibility only; the list is already confirmed and its ambition is proportionate. Evidence: deploys happen by a developer running deploy.sh from a laptop against production; there is also an unused pipeline definition last edited three years ago. Two retry helpers exist, one wrapping the other. The owner says: the laptop deploy is how we do it and I hate it, but I am not fixing it this quarter. I have no idea why there are two retry helpers.
checks: Record the laptop deploy as tolerated, with the owner's account of what is wrong, and not as an adopted or endorsed delivery practice.
Leave delivery open or deferred with a revisit condition; do not design or start the replacement.
Mark the retry helpers and the stale pipeline unexamined rather than inferring a convention from them.
Place these standings in the guide beside the billing code and link from the charter.
Go through all six concerns for the responsibility.

cases.prompt: Use clny-plan-implementation. Requirements are established: add CSV export to the reports page. The repository's engineering entry point has a charter marker with version 0.3.0. The installed skills are a later version whose changelog has one non-blocking entry after 0.3.0, requiring each responsibility to record who is notified when its health check fails.
checks: Tell the user the versions differ and summarize the intervening entry.
Offer clny-configure to bring the repository up to date; do not run the charter interview inside planning.
Continue planning the export because the entry is not blocking.
Do not rewrite the marker.
